title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: Tame aje khush cho?
options: Ha, hu aje bahu khush chu.
Na, mane bhukh lage che.
Hu Surat ma rahu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu aje bahu khush chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Mari ben aje dukhi che.
options: My sister is sad today.
My sister is happy today.
My mother is sad today.
questions.correctAnswer: My sister is sad today.

questions.sentence: Tu kem khush che?
options: Maro mitra aje ave che.
Hu bahu dukhi chu.
Mane kai khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Maro mitra aje ave che.
questions.translatedSentence: My friend is coming today.

questions.sentence: Maro mitra bahu khush che.
options: My friend is very happy.
My friend is very sad.
My friend is very tired.
questions.correctAnswer: My friend is very happy.

questions.sentence: Shu thayu, tame dukhi lago cho.
options: Kai nahi, hu thodo dukhi chu.
Ha, hu bahu khush chu.
Hu Ahmedabad thi avu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Kai nahi, hu thodo dukhi chu.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nothing, I am a little sad.

questions.sentence: Mane aje bahu khushi che.
options: I feel very happy today.
I feel very tired today.
I am very busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel very happy today.

questions.sentence: Tame udas kem cho?
options: Mane maru ghar yaad ave che.
Mane dhokla bahu game che.
Hu roj chalva jau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane maru ghar yaad ave che.
questions.translatedSentence: I am missing my home.

questions.sentence: Hu udas nathi, hu majama chu.
options: I am not sad, I am fine.
I am not happy, I am tired.
I am not sad, I am angry.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not sad, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Aje badha bahu khush che!
options: Ha, aje bahu maja ave che.
Na, mane khabar nathi.
Hu atyare ghare jau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, aje bahu maja ave che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it is a lot of fun today.

questions.sentence: Tame thaki gaya cho?
options: Ha, hu aje bahu thaki gayo chu.
Na, mane gusso ave che.
Hu roj cha piu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu aje bahu thaki gayo chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very tired today.

questions.sentence: Hu bahu thakelo chu, mare sui javu che.
options: I am very tired, I want to sleep.
I am very tired, I want to eat.
I am very hungry, I want to sleep.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very tired, I want to sleep.

questions.sentence: Tu kem gusse che?
options: Mari bus aje bahu modi che.
Hu atyare bahu khush chu.
Mane rat ma dar lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mari bus aje bahu modi che.
questions.translatedSentence: My bus is very late today.

questions.sentence: Mane thodo gusso ave che.
options: I am a little angry.
I am a little scared.
I am a little tired.
questions.correctAnswer: I am a little angry.

questions.sentence: Tamne dar lage che?
options: Ha, mane thodo dar lage che.
Na, mane bhukh lagi che.
Ha, hu bahu khush chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane thodo dar lage che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am a little scared.

questions.sentence: Rat ma mane andhara thi dar lage che.
options: I am afraid of the dark at night.
I do not like the dark at night.
I feel cold at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I am afraid of the dark at night.

questions.sentence: Tane kantalo ave che?
options: Ha, mane bahu kantalo ave che.
Na, mane bahu gusso ave che.
Ha, hu kale Vadodara jais.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane bahu kantalo ave che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am really bored.

questions.sentence: Ghar ma besi ne mane kantalo ave che.
options: I get bored sitting at home.
I get tired sitting at home.
I get angry sitting at home.
questions.correctAnswer: I get bored sitting at home.

questions.sentence: Chal, aapne patang chagavva jaie.
options: Na, hu atyare bahu thakelo chu.
Ha, mane bahu dar lage che.
Na, mane kantalo bilkul nathi avto.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, hu atyare bahu thakelo chu.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am too tired right now.

questions.sentence: Kem cho, badhu barabar che?
options: Ha, hu majama chu, aabhar.
Na, hu atyare ghare jau chu.
Mane thodi chaas joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu majama chu, aabhar.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Tame aje kem cho?
options: How are you today?
Where are you today?
What are you doing today?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you today?

questions.sentence: Tu kem che, badhu thik che ne?
options: Ha yaar, badhu thik che.
Ha, tame bahu majama cho.
Na, tu kya rahe che?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha yaar, badhu thik che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes buddy, everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Tamari tabiyat atyare kevi che?
options: How are you feeling right now?
How was your health last week?
Where do you feel the pain now?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you feeling right now?

questions.sentence: Tamaro chehro udas kem lage che?
options: Mane aje thodu saru nathi lagtu.
Mane thepla bahu bhave che.
Hu kale Vadodara gayo hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane aje thodu saru nathi lagtu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am not feeling very good today.

questions.sentence: Shu thayu, tame thik to cho ne?
options: What happened, are you all right?
What happened, where did you go?
What is this, are you coming along?
questions.correctAnswer: What happened, are you all right?

questions.sentence: Tamne shu takleef thay che?
options: Mane matha ma dukhavo thay che.
Mane bahu khushi thay che.
Mane aje bahu maja avi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane matha ma dukhavo thay che.
questions.translatedSentence: I have a headache.

questions.sentence: Tamari ben ne kem che, e majama che?
options: How is your sister, is she well?
Where is your sister, is she at home?
Who is your sister, is she here?
questions.correctAnswer: How is your sister, is she well?

questions.sentence: Tame aje bahu shant cho, kem?
options: Kai nahi, hu thodo thakelo chu.
Ha, hu roj bahu bolu chu.
Na, mane atyare bhukh nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kai nahi, hu thodo thakelo chu.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nothing, I am a bit tired.

questions.sentence: Mane aje bahu chinta thay che.
options: Chinta na karo, badhu saru thai jashe.
Ha, mane pan bhukh lage che.
Tame Ahmedabad ma kya raho cho?
questions.correctAnswer: Chinta na karo, badhu saru thai jashe.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, everything will turn out fine.

questions.sentence: Chinta na kar, hu tari sathe chu.
options: Do not worry, I am with you.
Do not worry, I will call you.
Do not be angry, I am with you.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not worry, I am with you.

questions.sentence: Hu aa kaam nahi kari saku.
options: Tame chokkas kari shakso, mane vishvas che.
Ha, aa kaam tamara mate bahu sahelu che.
Mane pan aa kaam bilkul nathi gamtu.
questions.correctAnswer: Tame chokkas kari shakso, mane vishvas che.
questions.translatedSentence: You can definitely do it, I believe in you.

questions.sentence: Rado nahi, badhu thik thai jashe.
options: Do not cry, everything will be all right.
Do not worry, everything is already fine.
Do not cry, I am going home now.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not cry, everything will be all right.

questions.sentence: Mari pariksha bahu kharab gai.
options: Vandho nahi, agli var saru thashe.
Bahu saras, tamne abhinandan!
Ha, mane pan pariksha bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Vandho nahi, agli var saru thashe.
questions.translatedSentence: Never mind, it will go better next time.

questions.sentence: Tame ekla nathi, ame badha tamari sathe chie.
options: You are not alone, we are all with you.
You are not late, we are all waiting for you.
You are not alone, we are all at home.
questions.correctAnswer: You are not alone, we are all with you.

questions.sentence: Mane atyare bahu dar lage che.
options: Gabhrao nahi, hu ahi ja chu.
Ha, mane pan bahu kantalo ave che.
Tame gai kale kya hata?
questions.correctAnswer: Gabhrao nahi, hu ahi ja chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not panic, I am right here.

questions.sentence: Thodo aram karo, tame bahu thaki gaya cho.
options: Rest a little, you are very tired.
Work a little, you are very tired.
Rest a little, you are not tired at all.
questions.correctAnswer: Rest a little, you are very tired.

questions.sentence: Aabhar, tamari vaat thi mane saru lagyu.
options: Ema shu, mitro aa mate ja hoy che.
Na, mane e vishe kai khabar nathi.
Ha, hu atyare bahu dukhi chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ema shu, mitro aa mate ja hoy che.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nothing, that is what friends are for.

questions.sentence: Tamne dhokla game che?
options: Ha, mane dhokla bahu game che.
Na, mane dhokla banavta nathi avadta.
Mane khabar nathi ke dhokla kya male che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane dhokla bahu game che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like dhokla a lot.

questions.sentence: Mane undhiyu bhave che, pan bahu tikhu nahi.
options: I like undhiyu, but not too spicy.
I like undhiyu, but not too sweet.
I do not like undhiyu because it is spicy.
questions.correctAnswer: I like undhiyu, but not too spicy.

questions.sentence: Tane shu pivu game che, cha ke chaas?
options: Mane garmi ma chaas vadhare game che.
Mane cha banavta nathi avadtu.
Hu roj savare chaas vechu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane garmi ma chaas vadhare game che.
questions.translatedSentence: In this heat I prefer buttermilk.

questions.sentence: Mane vahelu uthvu nathi gamtu.
options: I do not like waking up early.
I do not like sleeping late.
I do not want to wake up right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like waking up early.

questions.sentence: Tamari iccha shu che, kya farva javu che?
options: Mane Gir ma sinh jova javu che.
Mane atyare ghare ja rehvu che.
Mane farva javu bilkul nathi gamtu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane Gir ma sinh jova javu che.
questions.translatedSentence: I would love to go see the lions in Gir.

questions.sentence: Mane uttarayan ma patang chagavvi bahu game che.
options: I really love flying kites during Uttarayan.
I really want to fly a kite tomorrow morning.
I really like watching the kite festival on television.
questions.correctAnswer: I really love flying kites during Uttarayan.

questions.sentence: Tamne cha ma sakar joie che?
options: Na, mane sakar vagar ni cha game che.
Ha, pan mane cha bilkul nathi bhavti.
Ha, mane cha ma limbu joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mane sakar vagar ni cha game che.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I like my tea without sugar.

questions.sentence: Mane bhid ma javu jara pan nathi gamtu.
options: I do not like going into crowds at all.
I do not like going out in the rain at all.
I do not want to go into that crowd right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like going into crowds at all.

questions.sentence: Kale rajaa che, tare shu karvu che?
options: Mare Sabarmati ashram jova javu che.
Mare kale vahela kaam par javu che.
Mane rajaa no divas bilkul nathi gamto.
questions.correctAnswer: Mare Sabarmati ashram jova javu che.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to go see Sabarmati Ashram.

questions.sentence: Mane lage che ke aa film bahu saras hati, tamne shu lage che?
options: Mane pan gami, pan ant thodo nabalo hato.
Mane khabar nathi ke film joya pachi shu thay che.
Ha, mane atyare bahu bhukh lage che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane pan gami, pan ant thodo nabalo hato.
questions.translatedSentence: I liked it too, but the ending was a bit weak.

questions.sentence: Hu tamari vaat sathe sahmat chu, pan mane thodu alag pan lage che.
options: I agree with you, but I also see it a little differently.
I disagree with you, and I see it completely differently.
I agree with you, so I have nothing more to say.
questions.correctAnswer: I agree with you, but I also see it a little differently.

questions.sentence: Mane maf karjo, hu gai kale tamne phone karvanu bhuli gayo.
options: Vandho nahi, mane khabar hati ke tame vyast hata.
Ha, mane tamara par gusso che ane hu have vaat nahi karu.
Aabhar, tame gai kale mane be var phone karyo hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Vandho nahi, mane khabar hati ke tame vyast hata.
questions.translatedSentence: It is all right, I knew that you were busy.

questions.sentence: Jo tame vahela avya hot to aapne sathe jami shakya hot.
options: If you had come earlier, we could have eaten together.
If you come early tomorrow, we will eat together.
If you had come earlier, I would have gone home.
questions.correctAnswer: If you had come earlier, we could have eaten together.

questions.sentence: Mane nathi lagtu ke aa kaam aje puru thashe.
options: Hu sahmat chu, pan aapne prayatna to karie.
Ha, aa kaam to gai kale ja puru thai gayu hatu.
Mane aa kaam bilkul nathi gamtu, etle hu nahi karu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu sahmat chu, pan aapne prayatna to karie.
questions.translatedSentence: I agree, but let us at least give it a try.

questions.sentence: Mane dukh che ke me tamne kharab lagadyu, mari evi iccha na hati.
options: I am sorry that I hurt your feelings, that was not my intention.
I am glad that I told you the truth, that was my intention.
I am sorry that I arrived late, but it was not my fault.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry that I hurt your feelings, that was not my intention.

questions.sentence: Tame kai bolta kem nathi, tamne maro nirnay nathi gamyo?
options: Evu nathi, mane vichar karva thodo vadhare samay joie che.
Ha, mane tamaro nirnay bahu gamyo, etle hu chup chu.
Na, mane khabar nathi ke tame atyare kya raho cho.
questions.correctAnswer: Evu nathi, mane vichar karva thodo vadhare samay joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: It is not that, I just need a little more time to think.

questions.sentence: Hu gusse hato etle kadvu bolyo, mane maf karsho?
options: I was angry, so I spoke harshly; will you forgive me?
I was tired, so I said nothing; will you forgive me?
I am angry, so I will not be speaking to you again.
questions.correctAnswer: I was angry, so I spoke harshly; will you forgive me?

questions.sentence: Aapne aa vishe alag alag vichar dharavie chie, pan aapne mitro to chie ne?
options: Chokkas, mat bhale alag hoy, aapni dosti evi ne evi ja che.
Na, jo tamaro mat alag hoy to hu tamari sathe vaat nahi karu.
Ha, mane khabar nathi ke aapne kyare malya hata.
questions.correctAnswer: Chokkas, mat bhale alag hoy, aapni dosti evi ne evi ja che.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, our opinions may differ, but our friendship stays exactly the same.
